recipe.visualDefinition: A minimalist, high-contrast composition featuring a central row of large, custom-lettered characters designed as impossible geometric objects (Escher-style) in black outlines on a stark white background, accompanied by a small secondary line of sans-serif text.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between complex 3D illusions and flat 2D white space
Scale disparity between the massive central lettering and the tiny metadata text
Uniformity of line weight across all geometric shapes
Horizontal alignment of disparate geometric forms
coreInvariants: Consistent black stroke weight for all 3D elements
Isometric or axonometric perspective used to create paradoxes
No shading or gradients; purely linear representation

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary typographic element is centered horizontally and vertically, occupying approximately 60% of the width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central row of impossible geometric letters.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the large geometric shapes, follows the horizontal line, and then jumps to the smaller text positioned above the first character.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space surrounds the central elements, creating a sense of clinical precision and focus.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black for all outlines and text.

letterConstructionRules: Each letter is an impossible object (e.g., Penrose triangle, blivet, or M.C. Escher-inspired paradoxes)
Uniform stroke thickness for all edges
Open-ended forms that loop back on themselves in ways that defy 3D physics
characterSpecificRedesigns: E-like shape constructed from three parallel cylinders merging into a single vertical bar
N-like shape using overlapping rectangular prisms
A-like shape based on the Penrose triangle

anatomy.terminals: Flat or rounded depending on the specific illusion

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme scale contrast between illustrative display type and functional metadata type.

candidateDirections.reason: For the small metadata text to provide a clean, geometric contrast.
The main letters must be hand-drawn as vector paths to achieve the impossible geometry.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a solid white square canvas. In the center, illustrate a series of 6 impossible geometric objects arranged in a horizontal row, each resembling a letter of the alphabet using only black outlines.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a small line of sans-serif text in all-caps, positioned just above the far-left geometric object, aligned to its left edge.

verificationChecks: Are all geometric shapes impossible in 3D space?
Is the stroke weight consistent across all shapes?
Is the background pure white with no texture?
Is the secondary text significantly smaller than the main shapes?

mustRedesign: Any specific brand names or logos
The exact configuration of the impossible 'E' and 'G' to ensure original artwork
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no overlapping lines create unintended intersections.
Check that the isometric angles are consistent across all letters.
Verify the small text is legible but subordinate.
Confirm the composition is perfectly centered.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Isometric Impossible Objects] + [Monolinear Outlines] + [Extreme Scale Contrast] + [Minimalist White Space].
